## What this changes

<!-- One or two sentences. The reviewer reads the diff against this. -->

## How it was tested

<!--
Evidence, not a claim. The command you ran and what it printed, a new test and
what it fails on without the fix, or a screenshot. "Tested locally" is not an
answer.
-->

## How to undo it

Revert, turn a flag off, roll back a release — name the one that applies.

If the honest answer is "you can't", say so. That answer is not a blocker, but

it regardless of how small the diff is.
